title: EDW Migration Copilot
description: Control-plane copilot for EDW migration runs: Gate status, inventory, backlog, reconcile, agent timeline, and handoffs. Prefer ops.migration_manifest_current, ops.migration_inventory, ops.migration_backlog, ops.proc_conversion_map, ops.reconcile_results, and ops.agent_events. Show precise counts. Domain mart questions are added when gold/silver tables exist. Gate pass and ship both mean SHIP.

question: Did the last migration run ship?
Which agents ran this run and when?
Which convert items are ok vs blocked?
Show the agent timeline for the latest run

example_question_sqls.question: Did the last migration run ship?
example_question_sqls.sql: SELECT run_id, gate, CASE WHEN lower(gate) IN ('pass', 'ship') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate_pass FROM ops.migration_manifest_current ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

example_question_sqls.question: Which agents ran this run and when?
example_question_sqls.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM ops.agent_events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT run_id FROM ops.migration_manifest_current ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS run_id) SELECT agent, min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts, count(*) AS events FROM ops.agent_events e CROSS JOIN latest WHERE e.run_id = latest.run_id AND lower(event) IN ('started','completed','handoff','blocked','failed','subagentstart','subagentstop') GROUP BY agent ORDER BY first_ts

example_question_sqls.question: Which convert items are ok vs blocked?
example_question_sqls.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM ops.agent_events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT run_id FROM ops.migration_manifest_current ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS run_id) SELECT legacy_proc, target_path, status FROM ops.proc_conversion_map m CROSS JOIN latest WHERE m.run_id = latest.run_id ORDER BY status, legacy_proc

example_question_sqls.question: What was the last handoff?
example_question_sqls.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM ops.agent_events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT run_id FROM ops.migration_manifest_current ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1)) AS run_id) SELECT get_json_object(detail, '$.from') AS from_agent, get_json_object(detail, '$.to') AS to_agent, get_json_object(detail, '$.item_id') AS item_id, get_json_object(detail, '$.outcome') AS outcome, ts FROM ops.agent_events e CROSS JOIN latest WHERE e.run_id = latest.run_id AND lower(event) = 'handoff' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
